text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0900 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne down on lower CBOT soycomplex calls with losses limited by a lack of sellers with WCE canola overbought relative to CBOT soybeans on Wednesday. July WCE futures crush margin fell to -5.82 Wednesday from +3.39 Tuesday. Canada's dollar was flat at C$1.3763 against the U.S. dollar, fell to 83.98 yen stood unchanged at 1.2552 marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 a tonne down on allied markets.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 down on lower CBOT corn calls and ideal growing conditions in Alberta with some dryness concerns in southeast Saskatchewan limiting losses.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 lower on U.S. corn and wheat calls with technical gaps seen above the market.
FEED PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 down on CBOT soymeal calls.
OATS - Steady to US$0.50 lower on allied markets.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
